purpose: Water-only concept preview; not integrated into the running game.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone water-surface material concept for a cheerful high-quality pixel-art catgirl swimming-pool physics game.
Draw ONE image containing ONLY POOL WATER, edge-to-edge. Target1536x768, landscape2:1. Straight-down orthographic view, no horizon, no perspective composition. No UI, border, pool rim, deck, cats, people, floats, plants, text, labels, arrows or comparison panels. No tiles or visible objects under water. This is a visual concept ONLY, not yet a game asset integration.
Art direction: premium handcrafted pixel-art swimming-pool WATER. Fresh clear aquamarine and soft swimming-pool blue, subtly deeper cool teal-blue underlayers, a sunlit clean summer feeling. Tangible optical depth through translucent-looking overlapping color patches, not flat cyan. Irregular fine sunlight caustic networks, gently bent and broken luminous filaments, variation in cell sizes and direction. Layer broad low-contrast slow undulation underneath smaller delicate caustics. Caustics use pale turquoise highlights, tiny restrained ivory highlights at a few junctions; most water remains calm and readable so small moving game characters would stand out. Balanced moderate contrast, light visible depth, still welcoming and bright, no dark abyss.
PIXEL REQUIREMENT: clearly deliberate square pixel clusters, crisp stepped curved boundaries, cohesive limited palette with rich closely related hues. Around a480x240logicalpixel-grid feeling scaled cleanly for this concept, with clustered dithering sparingly at transitional edges. Preserve graceful watery movement within pixel technique. NO photorealism, NO smooth vector lines, NO blurry airbrush gradients or generic noise. Structure should feel hand-selected and natural rather than a procedural repeated diagonal wallpaper.
Avoid: giant repeated X shapes, diamond lattice, identical intersecting zigzags, hard neon outlines, plastic/glass look, oil paint, watercolor paper, flat cheap gradient, glitter stars, bokeh dots, sparkly particles, ocean foam, beach shoreline, waves cresting, circular impact rings, reflected clouds, obvious repeating stamp patterns. Keep ALL canvas pure water and no foreground effects. Match a cute polished pixel-game world without imitating any particular screenshot. Do not depict the whole game or an empty bounded pool. ONE uninterrupted rectangle of nuanced clear swimming-pool water.
